I'll bid $281 to match p3's current high bid. Ventnor is a cheap blocker and trade chip. I need to preserve cash for Tennessee, B&O, and Short Line. I won't chase this yellow property further.

Marvin Gardens is still unowned. If p3 wins Ventnor, they could complete the yellow set by acquiring it next.

Tennessee is the bigger threat. p1 owns St. James, New York Ave, Kentucky, and Indiana and needs Tennessee to complete an orange monopoly. Ventnor is only $20 over face. I'm weighing whether to bid or drop.

I'll drop out. I have no yellows to complete, and p3 can still pair Ventnor with Atlantic. I need cash for Tennessee, B&O, and Short Line. My railroads and water works provide steady income.

I'll keep my bid strategy private. No player has a monopoly yet, so rent is low. I'll drop out.

p3 has no monopoly yet. Rent risk is low. Liquidity matters more than rent buffer. If I own Ventnor, p3 cannot complete the yellow set even if they acquire Marvin. That makes the auction a strategic block.
